results.title: Can Africa turn US-China rivalry into better deals? - African Business
results.snippet: Indeed, Chinese investment has helped expand processing and industrial activity, including at the Chambishi Multi-Facility Economic Zone. But a 2024 report for Japan’s development agency, JICA, cited concerns raised by Zambian entrepreneurs about the zone’s reliance on Chinese imports and the weak links between economic zones and local businesses.
